extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.

faqs.q: What is a 12x12 300 HP frac transfer pump used for?
faqs.a: A frac transfer pump feeds the frac pumpers from the blenders or from storage at the required suction flow rate. This high-flow centrifugal pump has a 12-inch suction and 12-inch discharge, 300 HP, on a transport skid with a diesel-hydraulic drive.

faqs.q: What size and power is the 12x12 300 HP frac transfer pump?
faqs.a: It is a centrifugal pump with a 12-inch suction by 12-inch discharge, rated 300 HP, driven by a diesel-hydraulic drive on a transport skid. State the required flow and head on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What pump makes can the 12x12 300 HP frac transfer pump use?
faqs.a: The centrifugal pump make is selectable from Gardner Denver, MCM, NOV or Serva. Choose to match your spares and the duty on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What drive options does the 12x12 300 HP frac transfer pump offer?
faqs.a: Drive options are an electric motor (ABB, WEG or Valiadis), a diesel engine (CAT, Deutz, Cummins, Perkins, Detroit Diesel or Volvo Penta), or a hydraulic motor (Denison or Veljan). This listing is the diesel-hydraulic version.

faqs.q: How is the 12x12 300 HP frac transfer pump mounted?
faqs.a: It is skid-mounted, and trailer-mounted and truck-mounted variants are available on registration-ready chassis. State the transport needs on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What does the 12x12 300 HP frac transfer pump connect to?
faqs.a: It takes fluid from the [frac blender](/p/frac-blender-mfr-50-50-bbl-min-auto-density-control-chemical-additive-system) or from storage such as a [frac tank](/p/frac-tank-500-bbl-insulated-trailer-mounted-road-registered) and feeds the frac pumpers. See [frac transfer pumps](/c/frac-transfer-pumps).

faqs.q: How does the 12x12 300 HP frac transfer pump differ from a frac pumper?
faqs.a: The transfer pump is a low-pressure, high-flow centrifugal booster, while the [frac pumper](/p/frac-pumper-2-500-hp-trailer-mounted-fleet-networked-dnv-optional) is a high-pressure triplex unit. The transfer pump keeps the pumpers fed.

faqs.q: Where is the 12x12 300 HP frac transfer pump used?
faqs.a: It is used on hydraulic fracturing fleets to deliver slurry or fluid to the suction of the pumpers. See the guide on [frac and stimulation equipment](/blog/frac-and-stimulation-equipment).

faqs.q: What should I send for a frac transfer pump quotation?
faqs.a: Send the required flow and suction pressure, the pump make, the drive type and make, and the mounting (skid, trailer or truck).

faqs.q: Can the 12x12 300 HP frac transfer pump be driven electrically?
faqs.a: Yes, the listing offers an electric motor drive (ABB, WEG or Valiadis) as an alternative to the diesel-hydraulic drive. State the supply and area classification on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Why is a transfer pump needed on a frac fleet?
faqs.a: The pumpers need a steady, pressurised suction supply, and the transfer pump provides it at the required suction flow rate.

faqs.q: Does Indus stock the 12x12 300 HP frac transfer pump?
faqs.a: Yes. We list the 12x12 300 HP frac transfer pump as ex-stock from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Pump make and drive are quoted to your specification. Send your configuration and destination through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
